description: This file defines the HarRouter class used for handling HTTP request routing based on HAR files within the Playwright testing framework. It manages request interception, response mocking, and route management.

classes.name: HarRouter
classes.description: A class that manages routing of network requests based on HAR files, allowing for request interception, response fulfillment, redirection, and error handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to asynchronously create a HarRouter instance by opening a HAR file.

methods.name: addContextRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a BrowserContext to intercept requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: addPageRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a Page to intercept requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the HAR file and cleans up resources.
